You are the implementing engineer for Atlas ERP, in '/Users/taha/Claude projects/expremental ERP/atlas-erp' on branch feat/inventory-counts (dev merged; inventory 5.1-5.3 done — items, moves/quants, MAV+FIFO costing with event-driven journals). NO git commands. uv at ~/.local/bin/uv; run `cd backend && ~/.local/bin/uv run <cmd>`. PostgreSQL 16 at postgresql+asyncpg://atlas:atlas@localhost:55432/atlas.

This is the LAST Phase 5 task — completes the inventory module.

READ FIRST (binding): docs/architecture.md D-020 (costing — a count variance is an ADJUSTMENT stock move, which already posts to the price-difference account via the 5.3 event handler — REUSE that path, do not reinvent posting), D-011 (events), D-013/D-014 (idempotency/pagination), D-022 (migrations), D-025 (tests); docs/research/s4hana-parity.md inventory 'physical inventory and cycle counting with difference posting = full'. Then read the 5.2/5.3 code you build ON: backend/app/modules/inventory/{constants.py, models/stock.py, models/costing.py, service/stock_moves.py (create_move — counts call this to post the variance ADJUSTMENT move), service/stock_quants.py (on-hand lookup), service/stock_reads.py, queries.py, stock_router.py, schemas.py}, backend/app/modules/inventory/service/__init__.py, backend/tests/modules/inventory/{factories.py, conftest.py, test_stock_moves.py}. Latest migration = 0022.

TASK — PLAN 5.4: physical/cycle counts with variance posting. A count session captures counted quantities per (item, bin[, lot]) against the system on-hand, and posting the count generates ADJUSTMENT stock moves for every variance (which flow through the 5.3 costing+event path to the price-difference account). Build:

1. `inventory/constants.py` additions: CountStatus (DRAFT|COUNTING|POSTED|CANCELLED); CountType (PHYSICAL|CYCLE) — physical = whole warehouse snapshot, cycle = a chosen subset of items/bins; permissions inventory.count.read, inventory.count.manage, inventory.count.post; number sequence 'inventory.count' (CNT-…).
2. `inventory/models/counts.py` (new; re-export in models/__init__.py):
   - `StockCount` (`inv_stock_counts`): UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, AuditMixin, TimestampMixin, DocumentMixin; count_number (claimed at creation), count_type (CountType), warehouse_id (composite tenant_fk), status (CountStatus), count_date (Date), description, posted_move_count (int default 0). 
   - `StockCountLine` (`inv_stock_count_lines`): UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, TimestampMixin; count_id (composite tenant_fk), item_id (composite tenant_fk), bin_id (composite tenant_fk), lot_id (nullable composite fk), system_qty (QuantityType — the on-hand SNAPSHOT captured when the line is added/when counting starts), counted_qty (QuantityType, nullable until counted), variance_qty (QuantityType — counted - system, stored at post time), adjustment_move_id (nullable composite fk to inv_stock_moves — the move that booked this line's variance). UNIQUE(tenant_id, count_id, item_id, bin_id, lot_id). Index (tenant_id, count_id). 
   Decide + document: system_qty is snapshotted when the line is created (so concurrent moves between snapshot and posting are visible as a re-snapshot warning OR the variance is computed against the LIVE on-hand at post time — the SAP-correct approach books the difference against live on-hand at posting to avoid double-counting concurrent moves; choose: at POST time, recompute each line's variance as counted_qty - LIVE on_hand(item,bin,lot), and post that, so concurrent moves are not clobbered. Store both the original snapshot system_qty AND the live value used. Document this clearly — it's the correctness crux of counting.)
3. `inventory/service/counts.py` (<400 lines; split if needed):
   - create_count (DRAFT, claims CNT number, validates warehouse), add/update lines (set counted_qty; only in DRAFT/COUNTING), a `populate_count(count_id)` helper that snapshots all current (item,bin,lot) quants for the warehouse into lines (for PHYSICAL) or for a given item/bin subset (CYCLE). start_counting (DRAFT→COUNTING). 
   - `post_count(session, tenant_id, count_id, *, idem)`: for each line with a counted_qty, compute variance = counted_qty - LIVE on_hand(item, bin, lot) at post time; if variance != 0 create an ADJUSTMENT stock move via the EXISTING create_move (positive variance = ADJUSTMENT in to_bin; negative = ADJUSTMENT out of from_bin) — these moves flow through 5.3 costing → the StockValued event → finance price-difference journal, so the GL variance posting is FREE (do NOT post journals here; reuse the move path). For a positive adjustment (stock found), create_move needs a unit_cost — use the item's current valuation avg cost (MAV) or latest layer cost (FIFO) via inventory queries, so found stock enters at current cost; document this. Link each adjustment move's document to the count document (docflow). Lines with counted_qty == None are skipped (not counted). Set status POSTED, store variance_qty + adjustment_move_id + posted_move_count. Idempotent (D-013). A count into a closed period fails because the adjustment move's COGS/variance journal hits the period trigger — the whole post rolls back (document; same guarantee as 5.3).
   - cancel_count (→ CANCELLED; only if not POSTED).
   - For a count with MANY lines (>100 variances), post as a BACKGROUND JOB (reuse the job runner pattern like bank import / depreciation; register 'inventory.count_post'); inline ≤100. 
4. `inventory/queries.py`: maybe `count_variance_summary` for reporting; keep minimal.
5. `inventory/count_router.py` (new, mounted into inventory router): POST /stock-counts (create, idempotent), POST /stock-counts/{id}/populate (snapshot lines), PATCH /stock-counts/{id}/lines/{line_id} (set counted_qty), POST /stock-counts/{id}/start, POST /stock-counts/{id}/post (idempotent; inline/202-job threshold), POST /stock-counts/{id}/cancel, GET /stock-counts (paginated, filter status/warehouse/type), GET /stock-counts/{id} (with lines, paginated or capped), GET /stock-counts/{id}/lines (paginated). Permission-guard all. PERFORMANCE §6.
6. Migration `0023_inventory_counts.py` (down_revision 0022): inv_stock_counts + inv_stock_count_lines + indexes. No trigger-bearing alters.
7. `docs/modules/inventory.md`: counting section (physical vs cycle, snapshot vs live-at-post variance, variance→ADJUSTMENT move→price-difference journal reuse, background posting, closed-period interaction). 
8. Tests `backend/tests/modules/inventory/test_counts.py` + `test_counts_api.py`:
   - create + populate snapshots current on-hand into lines; set counted_qty; post generates ADJUSTMENT moves ONLY for non-zero variances; a positive variance increases on-hand at current cost AND produces a Dr inventory / Cr price-difference journal (assert the journal exists via finance — reusing 5.3); a negative variance decreases on-hand and posts Dr price-difference / Cr inventory; lines with zero variance create no move; uncounted lines skipped.
   - **live-at-post correctness**: snapshot system_qty=10, then a concurrent issue of 2 (on-hand now 8) BEFORE posting, counted_qty=10 → variance booked = 10-8 = +2 (against LIVE on-hand), not 10-10=0; assert final on-hand = 10 and the concurrent issue was not clobbered. (This is the key test.)
   - idempotent post (replay returns same result, no double moves); re-post a POSTED count rejected; closed-period post rolls back (no moves, no journals, status stays not-POSTED).
   - >100-variance count → 202 job path completes; ≤100 inline.
   - cancel; RBAC; tenant isolation; pagination + query budgets.
   - pg-marked variant for the posting path on real Postgres.

RULES: no TODO/stub/dead-file; absolute imports; ruff + pytest FULLY green SQLite (`-m "not pg and not perf"`) AND `-m pg` (reset pg schema, upgrade head, run -m pg); delete stray atlas.db; files <400 lines; comments only non-obvious; don't print file contents. Update PROGRESS.md + tick PLAN 5.4 (NOTE: this completes Phase 5 — say so in PROGRESS). Run the STRUCTURE §9 self-check mentally and note it.

Return: files created/changed, the snapshot-vs-live-at-post variance decision + how concurrent moves are handled, how variance posting reuses the 5.3 path (confirm NO new journal code), the inline/job threshold, test counts (SQLite total+new, pg), migration number, confirmation Phase 5 is complete, and deviations with one-line justification.

431	**Decision.**
432	`inv_items.costing_method` enum MOVING_AVERAGE|FIFO, defaulted from item category, changeable only while no stock exists. Quantity SSOT remains `inv_stock_moves`.

434	**Moving average:** `inv_item_valuations` (tenant_id, item_id, warehouse_id, on_hand_qty QuantityType, avg_unit_cost full-precision, total_value MoneyType; UNIQUE(tenant_id, item_id, warehouse_id)), updated in the SAME transaction as the move under `select(...).with_for_update()` — on Postgres this takes the row lock serializing concurrent movers; on SQLite the dialect silently OMITS the FOR UPDATE clause (it is a no-op, not an error — clarified from the drafts' contradictory claims), and SQLite's single-writer lock provides equivalent serialization; the PG locking path is proven by pg-marked concurrency tests in CI.
435	- Receipt: `total_value += receipt_value; on_hand_qty += qty; avg_unit_cost = total_value / on_hand_qty` unrounded.
436	- Issue: `cogs = quantize(qty × avg_unit_cost, currency dp, HALF_UP); total_value -= cogs`; when on_hand_qty hits 0, residual total_value is flushed to the price-difference account so value and quantity never disagree.
437	
438	**FIFO:** `inv_cost_layers` (id, tenant_id, item_id, warehouse_id, receipt_move_id FK, received_at, original_qty, remaining_qty with CHECK `remaining_qty >= 0 AND remaining_qty <= original_qty`, unit_cost) plus `inv_layer_consumptions` (issue_move_id, layer_id, qty, cost). Issues consume layers ordered (received_at, id) ascending under `with_for_update`, one consumption row per touched layer; COGS = sum of per-layer quantized qty × unit_cost. Reversing an issue replays consumption rows backwards onto the exact layers; vendor returns consume layers normally; customer returns create a new layer at original COGS cost.
439	
440	**COGS consistency:** the in-process bus dispatches synchronously in the SAME session/transaction — inventory writes move + valuation/layer updates, publishes `inventory.stock.issued` carrying the computed cost and dimensions; `finance/handlers.py` posts the COGS journal entry (Dr COGS / Cr Inventory, dimensions copied: item, warehouse, cost center/WBS) before commit. One commit = move + valuation + journal + docflow link; a stock move can never exist without its journal entry or vice versa — explicitly recorded as the v1 decision whose future Kafka swap introduces a transactional outbox then, not now.
441	
442	**Negative stock forbidden outright:** service raises InsufficientStockError pre-flight, DB CHECKs (`on_hand_qty >= 0`, `remaining_qty >= 0`) back it; no per-warehouse opt-in. **Deadlock avoidance:** any transaction touching multiple valuation rows locks in (item_id, warehouse_id) sort order.

444	**Rationale.**
445	The parity doc commits to moving average AND FIFO per item category with event-driven COGS posting. Same-transaction handling is the only design keeping stock value in the journal identical to the valuation table without reconciliation machinery, while the bus abstraction still decouples the modules at code level per CLAUDE.md rule 6. Layer consumption rows make COGS auditable per layer and reversals exact rather than recomputed. 504	A single linear migration chain runs unmodified on both backends; migrations are the ONLY schema source — `Base.metadata.create_all` is banned everywhere INCLUDING tests, because triggers and raw DDL live only in migrations (tests would otherwise pass without the DB guards they claim to test). Every ALTER goes through `with op.batch_alter_table(...)` unconditionally — pass-through on Postgres, copy-rebuild on SQLite — which requires deterministic constraint names: `core/models.py` declares `MetaData(naming_convention={'ix':'ix_%(column_0_label)s','uq':'uq_%(table_name)s_%(column_0_name)s','ck':'ck_%(table_name)s_%(constraint_name)s','fk':'fk_%(table_name)s_%(column_0_name)s_%(referred_table_name)s','pk':'pk_%(table_name)s'})`; unnamed constraints cannot be dropped in SQLite batch mode.

509	4. Trigger/function DDL: per-dialect string pairs side by side in the migration body under `if op.get_bind().dialect.name == 'postgresql': op.execute(PG_SQL) else: op.execute(SQLITE_SQL)`; stable names `trg_<table>_<purpose>`; upgrades DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS then CREATE; downgrades drop. **Rule (load-bearing):** any migration that batch-alters a trigger-bearing table MUST re-execute that table's trigger DDL afterwards, because SQLite's copy-rebuild silently drops triggers — recorded in the migration template comment and caught by the guard tests, which run against the final migrated schema. 28	      supplies) — no on-hand quantity, no costing layer.
29	    - SERVICE: a non-physical line item (labour, fees) — never stocked, never tracked.
30	
31	    The service rejects tracking/costing participation for NON_STOCKED/SERVICE so the invariant
32	    "only STOCKED items have stock" holds from the masters up (validated again when moves land)."""
33	
34	    STOCKED = "STOCKED"
35	    NON_STOCKED = "NON_STOCKED"
36	    SERVICE = "SERVICE"
37	
38	
39	class CostingMethod(StrEnum):
40	    """How a stocked item is valued (D-020). Defaulted onto the item FROM its category at create
41	    but STORED on the item, because D-020 changes it only while no stock exists and the item is
42	    the costing unit. The moving-average valuation table and FIFO cost layers arrive in PLAN 5.3;
43	    5.1 only records the method so receipts know which engine to use."""
44	
45	    MOVING_AVERAGE = "MOVING_AVERAGE"
46	    FIFO = "FIFO"
47	
48	
49	class TrackingMode(StrEnum):
50	    """Whether a stocked item's units are individually identified (parity: batch/serial mgmt).
51	
52	    - NONE: fungible — quantity only (the default).
53	    - LOT: grouped by lot/batch code; one lot row per received batch (inv_lots), created at
54	      receipt (5.2+).
55	    - SERIAL: each unit uniquely identified; one inv_serials row per unit, created at receipt.
56	
57	    Tracking is PER ITEM and only meaningful for STOCKED items — the service forbids a non-NONE
58	    mode on NON_STOCKED/SERVICE items."""
59	
60	    NONE = "NONE"
61	    LOT = "LOT"
62	    SERIAL = "SERIAL"
63	
64	
65	class LotStatus(StrEnum):
66	    """Lifecycle of a lot/batch instance (parity: batch management). For 5.1 the table merely
67	    EXISTS — lots are created during receipts (5.2+); AVAILABLE is the default a receipt sets,
68	    the others are reached by later quality/expiry flows. No dead CRUD now (masters-only)."""
69	
70	    AVAILABLE = "AVAILABLE"
71	    BLOCKED = "BLOCKED"
72	    CONSUMED = "CONSUMED"
73	
74	
75	class SerialStatus(StrEnum):
76	    """Lifecycle of a serial-number instance (parity: serial management). Like LotStatus, the
77	    table exists for 5.1 and is populated at receipt (5.2+): IN_STOCK on receipt, ISSUED when
78	    the unit leaves, BLOCKED by quality holds."""
79	
80	    IN_STOCK = "IN_STOCK"
81	    ISSUED = "ISSUED"
82	    BLOCKED = "BLOCKED"
83	
84	
85	class MoveType(StrEnum):
86	    """The kind of stock movement (PLAN 5.2). The move's QUANTITY is always positive; the TYPE
87	    decides which of from_bin/to_bin participate (the direction), so a single signed-quantity
88	    column is never needed (the journal one-side-CHECK philosophy applied to stock):
89	
90	    - RECEIPT: stock enters a bin from outside inventory (purchase receipt, opening balance,
91	      positive count adjustment). to_bin REQUIRED, from_bin must be NULL.
92	    - ISSUE: stock leaves a bin to outside inventory (goods issue, scrap, negative count).
93	      from_bin REQUIRED, to_bin must be NULL.
94	    - TRANSFER: stock moves between two bins, conserving total on-hand. BOTH bins REQUIRED and
95	      they must differ.
96	    - ADJUSTMENT: a one-sided correction not tied to a business document. EXACTLY ONE of
97	      from_bin (a decrease) / to_bin (an increase) is set — the side carries the signed intent
98	      while quantity stays positive (a decrease is from_bin-only, an increase is to_bin-only)."""
99	
100	    RECEIPT = "RECEIPT"
101	    ISSUE = "ISSUE"
102	    TRANSFER = "TRANSFER"
103	    ADJUSTMENT = "ADJUSTMENT"
104	
105	
106	class MoveStatus(StrEnum):
107	    """Lifecycle of a stock move (PLAN 5.2). Unlike journal entries (DRAFT→POSTED), a stock move
108	    is created already POSTED and is IMMUTABLE: the move ledger IS the single source of truth for
109	    quantity, so a move never has a draft phase and is never edited or deleted — corrections are
110	    REVERSING moves (an opposite move linked via docflow, the append-only ledger philosophy of
111	    D-017 applied to stock). The column exists for symmetry with the rest of the platform and to
112	    leave room for a future draft/scheduled-move lifecycle, but every move 5.2 creates is POSTED."""
113	
114	    POSTED = "POSTED"
115	
116	
117	# Required bin sides per move type (PLAN 5.2): (from_bin_required, to_bin_required). ADJUSTMENT is
118	# the special case — exactly one side, validated separately (the service checks the XOR). Used by
119	# the create-move validator so the rule lives in ONE place, greppable and testable.
120	MOVE_BIN_SIDES: dict[MoveType, tuple[bool, bool]] = {
121	    MoveType.RECEIPT: (False, True),
122	    MoveType.ISSUE: (True, False),
123	    MoveType.TRANSFER: (True, True),
124	    # ADJUSTMENT: not in the strict table — the service enforces "exactly one side set".
125	}
126	
127	
128	# Stock-move document type + number sequence (D-012): a move registers in core_documents and
129	# claims its gapless number AT CREATION (a move is permanent at creation — POSTED immediately —
130	# so it is numbered immediately, the orders/receipts claim-timing branch, not the draft branch).
131	# The sequence year-resets (STK-2026-00001).
132	STOCK_MOVE_DOC_TYPE = "inventory.stock_move"
133	STOCK_MOVE_SEQUENCE_NAME = "inventory.stock_move"
134	STOCK_MOVE_NUMBER_PREFIX = "STK"
135	STOCK_MOVE_NUMBER_PADDING = 5
136	
137	# docflow link type joining a reversing move to the move it reverses (D-012 vocabulary): a
138	# correction is a NEW move, never an edit, so the ledger stays append-only.
139	STOCK_MOVE_REVERSES_LINK = "reverses"
140	
141	
142	# --- Costing (PLAN 5.3, D-020/D-037) ------------------------------------------
143	# The domain-event key inventory publishes when a move changes valuation (D-011). finance/handlers
144	# subscribes and posts the COGS/inventory journal in the SAME transaction (D-020). One key carrying
145	# the move_type; the handler branches on it for the per-move-type postings.
146	STOCK_VALUED_EVENT_KEY = "inventory.stock.valued"
147	
148	# docflow link type joining a stock move's document to the journal entry the costing event posts
149	# (D-012 vocabulary): the move "posts" the valuation journal, mirroring finance's own 'posts' edge.
150	STOCK_MOVE_POSTS_LINK = "posts"
151	
152	# The currency the COGS/inventory valuation journal posts in when the tenant has not configured a
153	# functional currency (the v1 single-currency default, mirroring the journal tests' USD/2-dp). When
154	# a functional currency IS configured the handler uses it; either way costs quantize to its decimals
155	# (D-015). Stored layer/valuation costs keep full scale-6 precision — only the posted COGS rounds.
156	DEFAULT_COSTING_CURRENCY = "USD"
157	
158	
159	# --- Permissions (D-009): one key per guarded endpoint action -----------------
160	INVENTORY_ITEM_READ = "inventory.item.read"
161	INVENTORY_ITEM_MANAGE = "inventory.item.manage"
162	INVENTORY_CATEGORY_READ = "inventory.category.read"
163	INVENTORY_CATEGORY_MANAGE = "inventory.category.manage"
164	INVENTORY_UOM_READ = "inventory.uom.read"
165	INVENTORY_UOM_MANAGE = "inventory.uom.manage"
166	# Warehouses + bins (PLAN 5.2): reference data — read vs create/edit.
167	INVENTORY_WAREHOUSE_READ = "inventory.warehouse.read"
168	INVENTORY_WAREHOUSE_MANAGE = "inventory.warehouse.manage"
169	INVENTORY_BIN_READ = "inventory.bin.read"
170	INVENTORY_BIN_MANAGE = "inventory.bin.manage"
171	# Stock moves (PLAN 5.2): read the move ledger + on-hand vs create a move (which is POSTED and
172	# changes on-hand, so it is its own action — the journal.post precedent).
173	INVENTORY_MOVE_READ = "inventory.move.read"
174	INVENTORY_MOVE_CREATE = "inventory.move.create"
175	# Stock valuation visibility (PLAN 5.3): reading the moving-average/FIFO valuation + cost layers is
176	# its own read action (a finance-adjacent concern — value, not just quantity), distinct from the
177	# move-ledger read so the value views can be granted to costing/controlling roles independently.
178	INVENTORY_VALUATION_READ = "inventory.valuation.read"
179

181	    INVENTORY_ITEM_READ,
182	    INVENTORY_ITEM_MANAGE,

1	"""The stock-move WRITE engine (PLAN 5.2, D-020/D-036): create_move (the heart) + reverse_move.
2	
3	The read paths (``get_move``, ``list_moves``, ``list_on_hand``) live in ``stock_reads.py`` (split at
4	the 400-line cap); this module imports ``get_move`` from there and the package ``__init__``
5	re-exports both halves as one surface.
6	
7	A stock move is the quantity SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH and is POSTED-at-creation + IMMUTABLE — there
8	is no draft phase, no edit, no delete; a correction is a NEW reversing move (the universal-journal
9	reversal philosophy of D-017 applied to stock). ``create_move``:
10	
11	1. validates — item is STOCKED; the move_type's required bin sides are present (constants
12	   MOVE_BIN_SIDES; ADJUSTMENT = exactly one side; TRANSFER = two DIFFERENT bins); bins exist and
13	   belong to ACTIVE warehouses; quantity > 0; the item's tracking mode is satisfied (lot/serial
14	   resolved, created on a receipt, required-existing on issue/transfer; serial ⇒ quantity == 1);
15	2. registers the document + claims the gapless STK number (D-012, at creation — a move is permanent
16	   at create);
17	3. inserts the StockMove (POSTED);
18	4. updates the quant rows in the SAME transaction — decrement from_bin, increment to_bin — through
19	   ``apply_bin_delta`` (the CHECK >= 0 + the pre-flight check forbid negative stock, D-020);
20	   transfer deltas are applied in deterministic bin-id order (deadlock avoidance, D-020).
21	
22	The whole thing is one unit of work: move + quant updates commit or roll back together, so the
23	ledger and the projection can never disagree. Idempotency (D-013) is owned by the endpoint.
24	Inventory imports only finance/queries downward (STRUCTURE §5); this engine imports neither.
25	"""
26	
27	from __future__ import annotations
28	
29	import uuid
30	from datetime import date
31	from decimal import Decimal
32	
33	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
34	
35	from app.core import docflow
36	from app.core.events import publish
37	from app.core.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
38	from app.core.numbering import claim_number, ensure_sequence
39	from app.modules.inventory.constants import (
40	    MOVE_BIN_SIDES,
41	    STOCK_MOVE_DOC_TYPE,
42	    STOCK_MOVE_NUMBER_PADDING,
43	    STOCK_MOVE_NUMBER_PREFIX,
44	    STOCK_MOVE_REVERSES_LINK,
45	    STOCK_MOVE_SEQUENCE_NAME,
46	    ItemType,
47	    MoveStatus,
48	    MoveType,
49	    TrackingMode,
50	)
51	from app.modules.inventory.models import Bin, Item, StockMove
52	from app.modules.inventory.schemas import StockMoveCreate
53	from app.modules.inventory.service import costing, costing_reversal
54	from app.modules.inventory.service.stock_quants import (
55	    apply_bin_delta,
56	    resolve_lot,
57	    resolve_serial,
58	)
59	from app.modules.inventory.service.stock_reads import get_move
60	
61	
62	async def _require_stocked_item(
63	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
64	) -> Item:
65	    item = await session.get(Item, item_id)
66	    if item is None or item.tenant_id != tenant_id:
67	        raise NotFoundError(message="Item not found", code="inventory.item_not_found")
68	    if ItemType(item.item_type) != ItemType.STOCKED:
69	        raise ValidationFailedError(
70	            message="Only stocked items participate in stock moves",
71	            code="inventory.item_not_stocked",
72	            details={"item_id": str(item_id), "item_type": item.item_type},
73	        )
74	    return item
75	
76	
77	async def _require_active_bin(
78	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, bin_id: uuid.UUID, *, side: str
79	) -> Bin:
80	    """The bin exists, belongs to this tenant, and its warehouse is active. A move never lands stock
81	    in (or pulls from) a bin whose warehouse was deactivated."""
82	    bin_row = await session.get(Bin, bin_id)
83	    if bin_row is None or bin_row.tenant_id != tenant_id:
84	        raise ValidationFailedError(
85	            message=f"The {side} bin does not exist",
86	            code="inventory.bin_not_found",
87	            details={"bin_id": str(bin_id), "side": side},
88	        )
89	    if not bin_row.is_active:
90	        raise ValidationFailedError(
91	            message=f"The {side} bin is inactive",
92	            code="inventory.bin_inactive",
93	            details={"bin_id": str(bin_id), "side": side},
94	        )
95	    return bin_row
96	
97	
98	def _validate_bin_sides(
99	    move_type: MoveType, from_bin_id: uuid.UUID | None, to_bin_id: uuid.UUID | None
100	) -> None:
101	    """Enforce the move_type ⇒ required-bin-side rule (constants.MOVE_BIN_SIDES). ADJUSTMENT is the
102	    special case: EXACTLY ONE side. TRANSFER additionally requires the two bins to differ."""
103	    if move_type == MoveType.ADJUSTMENT:
104	        if (from_bin_id is None) == (to_bin_id is None):
105	            raise ValidationFailedError(
106	                message="An adjustment sets exactly one of from_bin / to_bin",
107	                code="inventory.adjustment_one_side",
108	            )
109	        return
110	    from_required, to_required = MOVE_BIN_SIDES[move_type]
111	    if from_required and from_bin_id is None:
112	        raise ValidationFailedError(
113	            message=f"{move_type.value} requires a from_bin",
114	            code="inventory.move_from_bin_required",
115	        )
116	    if not from_required and from_bin_id is not None:
117	        raise ValidationFailedError(
118	            message=f"{move_type.value} must not set a from_bin",
119	            code="inventory.move_from_bin_forbidden",
120	        )
121	    if to_required and to_bin_id is None:
122	        raise ValidationFailedError(
123	            message=f"{move_type.value} requires a to_bin",
124	            code="inventory.move_to_bin_required",
125	        )
126	    if not to_required and to_bin_id is not None:
127	        raise ValidationFailedError(
128	            message=f"{move_type.value} must not set a to_bin",
129	            code="inventory.move_to_bin_forbidden",
130	        )
131	    if move_type == MoveType.TRANSFER and from_bin_id == to_bin_id:
132	        raise ValidationFailedError(
133	            message="A transfer must move between two different bins",
134	            code="inventory.transfer_same_bin",
135	        )
136	
137	
138	def _is_inbound(move_type: MoveType, to_bin_id: uuid.UUID | None) -> bool:
139	    """Whether the move adds stock (the costing-inbound side): a RECEIPT, or a positive ADJUSTMENT
140	    (to_bin set). The inbound side is where the REQUIRED entry unit_cost applies (D-020)."""
141	    return move_type == MoveType.RECEIPT or (
142	        move_type == MoveType.ADJUSTMENT and to_bin_id is not None
143	    )
144	
145	
146	def _validate_unit_cost(payload: StockMoveCreate, move_type: MoveType) -> Decimal | None:
147	    """Costing input rule (D-020): a RECEIPT / positive ADJUSTMENT REQUIRES ``unit_cost`` (the value
148	    stock enters at, > 0). An ISSUE / negative ADJUSTMENT / TRANSFER IGNORE any passed cost — the
149	    engine computes the outbound cost / carries the current valuation — so the move stores it as
150	    None
151	    and the engine fills it. Returns the validated entry cost (None for the computed sides)."""
152	    if _is_inbound(move_type, payload.to_bin_id):
153	        if payload.unit_cost is None or Decimal(payload.unit_cost) <= 0:
154	            raise ValidationFailedError(
155	                message="A receipt or stock-increase requires a positive unit cost",
156	                code="inventory.receipt_unit_cost_required",
157	            )
158	        return Decimal(payload.unit_cost)
159	    return None
160	
161	
162	async def _apply_quant_deltas(
163	    session: AsyncSession,
164	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
165	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
166	    lot_id: uuid.UUID | None,
167	    from_bin_id: uuid.UUID | None,
168	    to_bin_id: uuid.UUID | None,
169	    quantity: Decimal,
170	) -> None:
171	    """Update the maintained quant projection for one move (D-036): decrement from_bin, increment
172	    to_bin. The two sides are applied in deterministic bin-id order (deadlock avoidance, D-020:
173	    concurrent movers touching the same pair lock it in the same order). A decrement raises
174	    InsufficientStockError if it would go negative (no-negative-stock, D-020)."""
175	    deltas: list[tuple[uuid.UUID, Decimal]] = []
176	    if from_bin_id is not None:
177	        deltas.append((from_bin_id, -quantity))
178	    if to_bin_id is not None:
179	        deltas.append((to_bin_id, quantity))
180	    # Lock/update in ascending bin-id order so two concurrent transfers between the same bins
181	    # never deadlock by locking the pair in opposite orders (D-020 deadlock avoidance).
182	    for bin_id, delta in sorted(deltas, key=lambda pair: pair[0].bytes):
183	        await apply_bin_delta(session, tenant_id, item_id, bin_id, lot_id, delta)
184	
185	
186	async def create_move(
187	    session: AsyncSession,
188	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
189	    payload: StockMoveCreate,
190	    *,
191	    reversal_of: StockMove | None = None,
192	) -> StockMove:
193	    """Create + POST a stock move (the heart, PLAN 5.2/5.3). Validates everything (see module
194	    docstring), claims the gapless STK number, inserts the POSTED move, updates the quant
195	    projection,
196	    runs COSTING and publishes the valuation event — all in the SAME transaction (D-020). Raises 422
197	    InsufficientStockError when an issue/transfer exceeds on-hand; NotFound for a missing item; 422
198	    for a non-stocked item or a bin-side rule break. The caller commits via uow.
199	
200	    ``reversal_of`` (set by ``reverse_move``) runs the costing REVERSAL path instead of a fresh
201	    valuation: the reversing move replays the original's FIFO consumptions / re-applies its
202	    moving-average value and emits the OPPOSITE valuation event so the COGS journal is reversed too
203	    (D-020)."""
204	    move_type = MoveType(payload.move_type)
205	    quantity = Decimal(payload.quantity)
206	    if quantity <= 0:
207	        raise ValidationFailedError(
208	            message="Move quantity must be greater than zero",
209	            code="inventory.move_quantity_invalid",
210	            details={"quantity": str(quantity)},
211	        )
212	
213	    item = await _require_stocked_item(session, tenant_id, payload.item_id)
214	    _validate_bin_sides(move_type, payload.from_bin_id, payload.to_bin_id)
215	    # Costing input (D-020): a RECEIPT/positive-ADJUSTMENT requires the entry cost; computed sides
216	    # ignore it. Validated BEFORE any write so a missing cost fails fast (no number burned). A
217	    # reversal carries its cost from the original move (the costing reversal path), so it does not
218	    # need (and does not pass) an entry cost — skip the requirement.
219	    entry_cost = None if reversal_of is not None else _validate_unit_cost(payload, move_type)
220	    if payload.from_bin_id is not None:
221	        await _require_active_bin(session, tenant_id, payload.from_bin_id, side="from")
222	    if payload.to_bin_id is not None:
223	        await _require_active_bin(session, tenant_id, payload.to_bin_id, side="to")
224	
225	    # A receipt MAY create a lot/serial master instance (5.1 deferred that to receipts); an
226	    # issue/transfer/adjustment-decrease must reference one that already exists with stock.
227	    create_instance = move_type == MoveType.RECEIPT
228	    lot_id = await resolve_lot(
229	        session,
230	        tenant_id,
231	        item,
232	        lot_id=payload.lot_id,
233	        lot_code=payload.lot_code,
234	        create_if_missing=create_instance,
235	    )
236	    serial_id = await resolve_serial(
237	        session,
238	        tenant_id,
239	        item,
240	        serial_id=payload.serial_id,
241	        serial_code=payload.serial_code,
242	        create_if_missing=create_instance,
243	    )
244	    if TrackingMode(item.tracking_mode) == TrackingMode.SERIAL and quantity != 1:
245	        raise ValidationFailedError(
246	            message="A serial-tracked move has quantity 1 (a serial moves wholesale)",
247	            code="inventory.serial_quantity_invalid",
248	            details={"quantity": str(quantity)},
249	        )
250	
251	    move_date = payload.move_date or date.today()
252	    move_id = uuid.uuid4()
253	    document = await docflow.register_document(
254	        session,
255	        tenant_id,
256	        STOCK_MOVE_DOC_TYPE,
257	        move_id,
258	        doc_number=None,
259	        status=MoveStatus.POSTED.value,
260	    )
261	    # A move is permanent at creation (POSTED immediately), so the number is claimed now (D-012
262	    # claim-at-permanence, the orders/receipts branch, not the draft branch).
263	    await ensure_sequence(
264	        session,
265	        tenant_id,
266	        STOCK_MOVE_SEQUENCE_NAME,
267	        STOCK_MOVE_NUMBER_PREFIX,
268	        STOCK_MOVE_NUMBER_PADDING,
269	        year_reset=True,
270	    )
271	    move_number = await claim_number(
272	        session, tenant_id, STOCK_MOVE_SEQUENCE_NAME, on_date=move_date
273	    )
274	
275	    move = StockMove(
276	        id=move_id,
277	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
278	        document_id=document.id,
279	        move_number=move_number,
280	        move_type=move_type.value,
281	        item_id=item.id,
282	        quantity=quantity,
283	        base_uom_id=item.base_uom_id,
284	        from_bin_id=payload.from_bin_id,
285	        to_bin_id=payload.to_bin_id,
286	        lot_id=lot_id,
287	        serial_id=serial_id,
288	        move_date=move_date,
289	        reference=payload.reference,
290	        posted=True,
291	        # The validated entry cost on an inbound move; the costing engine fills the computed cost on
292	        # an outbound/transfer move below (D-020).
293	        unit_cost=entry_cost,
294	    )
295	    session.add(move)
296	    await session.flush()
297	
298	    await docflow.set_document_status(
299	        session, tenant_id, document.id, doc_number=move_number, status=MoveStatus.POSTED.value
300	    )
301	    await _apply_quant_deltas(
302	        session,
303	        tenant_id,
304	        item.id,
305	        lot_id,
306	        payload.from_bin_id,
307	        payload.to_bin_id,
308	        quantity,
309	    )
310	    # Costing IN THE SAME TRANSACTION (D-020), right after the quant update: update the
311	    # moving-average valuation / FIFO layers, write the computed cost onto the move, and publish the
312	    # StockValued event BEFORE the uow drains it — the COGS/inventory journal posts in this same
313	    # transaction, so the move + quant + valuation + journal commit or roll back as one. A
314	    # value-neutral within-warehouse transfer returns no event (no journal).
315	    if reversal_of is not None:
316	        result = await costing_reversal.reverse_costing(
317	            session, tenant_id, item, move, reversal_of
318	        )
319	    else:
320	        result = await costing.apply_costing(session, tenant_id, item, move)
321	    if result.event is not None:
322	        publish(session, result.event)
323	    return move
324	
325	
326	async def reverse_move(
327	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, move_id: uuid.UUID
328	) -> StockMove:
329	    """Reverse a posted move by posting an OPPOSITE move (PLAN 5.2): same item/quantity/lot/serial
330	    with from_bin and to_bin SWAPPED, linked to the original via docflow ('reverses'). The ledger
331	    stays append-only — corrections are new moves, never edits (D-017 philosophy). The reversing
332	    move restores the quants the original changed; a reversal that would itself go negative (the
333	    stock already left) raises InsufficientStockError like any other move. A move may be reversed
334	    once (a second reverse of the same original is rejected)."""
335	    original = await get_move(session, tenant_id, move_id)
336	    # Guard against double-reversal: a reversing move points back via docflow 'reverses'. Cheap
337	    # check — has any move already reversed this one?
338	    if await _already_reversed(session, tenant_id, original.document_id):
339	        raise ConflictError(
340	            message="This stock move has already been reversed",
341	            code="inventory.move_already_reversed",
342	        )
343	
344	    reversal_payload = StockMoveCreate(
345	        move_type=MoveType(original.move_type),
346	        item_id=original.item_id,
347	        quantity=Decimal(original.quantity),
348	        # Swap the directions so the reversing move undoes the original's quant deltas.
349	        from_bin_id=original.to_bin_id,
350	        to_bin_id=original.from_bin_id,
351	        lot_id=original.lot_id,
352	        serial_id=original.serial_id,
353	        move_date=date.today(),
354	        reference=f"Reversal of {original.move_number}",
355	    )
356	    # A reversal of a RECEIPT swaps to an ISSUE-shaped move (from set, to NULL) and vice versa; for
357	    # ADJUSTMENT/TRANSFER the swap stays the same move_type. The bin-side validator accepts the
358	    # swapped shape because the move_type's required side follows the populated bin.
359	    reversal_payload = _retype_for_reversal(reversal_payload, MoveType(original.move_type))
360	
361	    # Pass the original so create_move runs the costing REVERSAL (replay), not a fresh valuation,
362	    # and
363	    # publishes the OPPOSITE StockValued event so the COGS journal is reversed in the same
364	    # transaction (D-020).
365	    reversal = await create_move(
366	        session, tenant_id, reversal_payload, reversal_of=original
367	    )
368	    await docflow.link_documents(
369	        session,
370	        tenant_id,
371	        predecessor=original.document_id,
372	        successor=reversal.document_id,
373	        link_type=STOCK_MOVE_REVERSES_LINK,
374	    )
375	    return reversal
376	
377	
378	def _retype_for_reversal(payload: StockMoveCreate, original_type: MoveType) -> StockMoveCreate:
379	    """A RECEIPT reverses as an ISSUE and an ISSUE as a RECEIPT (the bin sides flip, so the type
380	    must too, or the bin-side validator rejects the swapped shape). TRANSFER and ADJUSTMENT keep
381	    their type — a swapped TRANSFER is still a TRANSFER, and a swapped ADJUSTMENT (the single side
382	    moves to the other side) is still an ADJUSTMENT."""
383	    if original_type == MoveType.RECEIPT:
384	        return payload.model_copy(update={"move_type": MoveType.ISSUE})
385	    if original_type == MoveType.ISSUE:
386	        return payload.model_copy(update={"move_type": MoveType.RECEIPT})
387	    return payload
388	
389	
390	async def _already_reversed(
391	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, document_id: uuid.UUID
392	) -> bool:
393	    """Whether a 'reverses' edge already points FROM this move's document (it has been reversed)."""
394	    chain = await docflow.get_document_chain(session, tenant_id, document_id)
395	    return any(
396	        edge.link_type == STOCK_MOVE_REVERSES_LINK
397	        and edge.predecessor_document_id == document_id
398	        for edge in chain.edges
399	    )

1	"""Quant maintenance + lot/serial resolution for the stock-move engine (PLAN 5.2, D-036).
2	
3	This file owns the side-effect helpers ``create_move`` orchestrates, kept separate so
4	``stock_moves.py`` stays the readable orchestration and both stay under the STRUCTURE §3 cap:
5	
6	- ``apply_bin_delta``: increment/decrement ONE (item, bin, lot) quant in the SAME transaction as
7	  the move. A decrement that would go negative raises InsufficientStockError BEFORE writing (the
8	  pre-flight half of D-020's no-negative-stock rule; the ``CHECK (on_hand_qty >= 0)`` is the DB
9	  backstop). Uses ``with_for_update`` to take the row lock on Postgres (serializing concurrent
10	  movers); on SQLite the dialect OMITS the clause (a no-op, not an error — D-020) and the
11	  single-writer lock serializes. A quant that reaches exactly 0 is DELETED so the projection holds
12	  only live stock and ``on_hand_by_bin`` never lists empty bins.
13	
14	- ``resolve_lot`` / ``resolve_serial``: turn a move's lot/serial intent into a master-row id,
15	  CREATING the master instance on a RECEIPT (5.1 deferred instance creation to receipts) and
16	  REQUIRING it to already exist with stock on an ISSUE/TRANSFER.
17	
18	Deadlock avoidance (D-020): a transfer touches two quant rows; the move engine locks them in a
19	deterministic order (it computes from/to deltas and calls ``apply_bin_delta`` for the lower bin id
20	first) so two concurrent movers never lock the same pair in opposite orders.
21	"""
22	
23	from __future__ import annotations
24	
25	import uuid
26	from datetime import UTC, datetime
27	from decimal import Decimal
28	
29	from sqlalchemy import select
30	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
31	
32	from app.core.exceptions import ValidationFailedError
33	from app.modules.inventory.constants import LotStatus, SerialStatus, TrackingMode
34	from app.modules.inventory.models import Item, Lot, SerialNumber, StockQuant
35	
36	
37	class InsufficientStockError(ValidationFailedError):
38	    """A move would drive an (item, bin, lot) on-hand below zero (D-020: negative stock forbidden).
39	    422 ``inventory.insufficient_stock`` — the pre-flight service check; the ``CHECK (on_hand_qty
40	    >= 0)`` on inv_stock_quants is the DB backstop that fires if the service check is bypassed."""
41	
42	    def __init__(
43	        self,
44	        *,
45	        item_id: uuid.UUID,
46	        bin_id: uuid.UUID,
47	        requested: Decimal,
48	        available: Decimal,
49	    ) -> None:
50	        super().__init__(
51	            message="Insufficient stock to issue from this bin",
52	            code="inventory.insufficient_stock",
53	            details={
54	                "item_id": str(item_id),
55	                "bin_id": str(bin_id),
56	                "requested": str(requested),
57	                "available": str(available),
58	            },
59	        )
60	
61	
62	async def _locked_quant(
63	    session: AsyncSession,
64	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
65	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
66	    bin_id: uuid.UUID,
67	    lot_id: uuid.UUID | None,
68	) -> StockQuant | None:
69	    """Load the (item, bin, lot) quant row FOR UPDATE, or None if it does not exist yet. The
70	    ``with_for_update`` takes the row lock on Postgres (D-020 concurrency path); SQLite omits it as
71	    a no-op. ``lot_id IS NULL`` is matched explicitly (a NULL lot is the fungible-stock quant)."""
72	    stmt = (
73	        select(StockQuant)
74	        .where(
75	            StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id,
76	            StockQuant.item_id == item_id,
77	            StockQuant.bin_id == bin_id,
78	            StockQuant.lot_id.is_(lot_id) if lot_id is None else StockQuant.lot_id == lot_id,
79	        )
80	        .with_for_update()
81	    )
82	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
83	
84	
85	async def apply_bin_delta(
86	    session: AsyncSession,
87	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
88	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
89	    bin_id: uuid.UUID,
90	    lot_id: uuid.UUID | None,
91	    delta: Decimal,
92	) -> None:
93	    """Add ``delta`` (signed) to the (item, bin, lot) quant in this transaction (D-036). A positive
94	    delta upserts/increments; a negative delta decrements and raises InsufficientStockError if the
95	    result would be < 0 (pre-flight, before any write). A row reaching exactly 0 is deleted. Locks
96	    the row FOR UPDATE first (PG serialization; SQLite no-op, D-020)."""
97	    quant = await _locked_quant(session, tenant_id, item_id, bin_id, lot_id)
98	    current = Decimal(quant.on_hand_qty) if quant is not None else Decimal(0)
99	    new_qty = current + delta
100	    if new_qty < 0:
101	        raise InsufficientStockError(
102	            item_id=item_id, bin_id=bin_id, requested=-delta, available=current
103	        )
104	    if quant is None:
105	        session.add(
106	            StockQuant(
107	                tenant_id=tenant_id,
108	                item_id=item_id,
109	                bin_id=bin_id,
110	                lot_id=lot_id,
111	                on_hand_qty=new_qty,
112	            )
113	        )
114	    elif new_qty == 0:
115	        await session.delete(quant)
116	    else:
117	        quant.on_hand_qty = new_qty
118	    await session.flush()
119	
120	
121	async def resolve_lot(
122	    session: AsyncSession,
123	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
124	    item: Item,
125	    *,
126	    lot_id: uuid.UUID | None,
127	    lot_code: str | None,
128	    create_if_missing: bool,
129	) -> uuid.UUID | None:
130	    """Resolve the lot a move applies to (PLAN 5.2). For a LOT-tracked item a lot is REQUIRED (by
131	    id, or by a new ``lot_code`` on a receipt when ``create_if_missing``). For an untracked item a
132	    lot is forbidden. Returns the lot id (None for untracked). Creating happens only on a receipt —
133	    an ISSUE/TRANSFER must reference an existing lot (its stock is then checked by the quant)."""
134	    tracking = TrackingMode(item.tracking_mode)
135	    if tracking != TrackingMode.LOT:
136	        if lot_id is not None or lot_code is not None:
137	            raise ValidationFailedError(
138	                message="This item is not lot-tracked; a lot must not be supplied",
139	                code="inventory.lot_not_applicable",
140	                details={"item_id": str(item.id)},
141	            )
142	        return None
143	
144	    if lot_id is not None:
145	        lot = await session.get(Lot, lot_id)
146	        if lot is None or lot.tenant_id != tenant_id or lot.item_id != item.id:
147	            raise ValidationFailedError(
148	                message="The referenced lot does not exist for this item",
149	                code="inventory.lot_not_found",
150	                details={"lot_id": str(lot_id)},
151	            )
152	        return lot.id
153	    if lot_code is not None and create_if_missing:
154	        return await _get_or_create_lot(session, tenant_id, item.id, lot_code)
155	    raise ValidationFailedError(
156	        message="A lot is required for this lot-tracked item",
157	        code="inventory.lot_required",
158	        details={"item_id": str(item.id)},
159	    )
160	
161	
162	async def _get_or_create_lot(
163	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID, lot_code: str
164	) -> uuid.UUID:
165	    existing = (
166	        await session.execute(
167	            select(Lot).where(
168	                Lot.tenant_id == tenant_id, Lot.item_id == item_id, Lot.lot_code == lot_code
169	            )
170	        )
171	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
172	    if existing is not None:
173	        return existing.id
174	    lot = Lot(
175	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
176	        item_id=item_id,
177	        lot_code=lot_code,
178	        status=LotStatus.AVAILABLE.value,
179	        received_at=datetime.now(UTC),
180	    )
181	    session.add(lot)
182	    await session.flush()
183	    return lot.id
184	
185	
186	async def resolve_serial(
187	    session: AsyncSession,
188	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
189	    item: Item,
190	    *,
191	    serial_id: uuid.UUID | None,
192	    serial_code: str | None,
193	    create_if_missing: bool,
194	) -> uuid.UUID | None:
195	    """Resolve the serial a move applies to (PLAN 5.2). For a SERIAL-tracked item a serial is
196	    REQUIRED (by id, or a new ``serial_code`` on a receipt); for an untracked item it is forbidden.
197	    A serial moves wholesale (the caller enforces quantity == 1). Returns the serial id (None for
198	    untracked). Creating happens only on a receipt."""
199	    tracking = TrackingMode(item.tracking_mode)
200	    if tracking != TrackingMode.SERIAL:
201	        if serial_id is not None or serial_code is not None:
202	            raise ValidationFailedError(
203	                message="This item is not serial-tracked; a serial must not be supplied",
204	                code="inventory.serial_not_applicable",
205	                details={"item_id": str(item.id)},
206	            )
207	        return None
208	
209	    if serial_id is not None:
210	        serial = await session.get(SerialNumber, serial_id)
211	        if serial is None or serial.tenant_id != tenant_id or serial.item_id != item.id:
212	            raise ValidationFailedError(
213	                message="The referenced serial does not exist for this item",
214	                code="inventory.serial_not_found",
215	                details={"serial_id": str(serial_id)},
216	            )
217	        return serial.id
218	    if serial_code is not None and create_if_missing:
219	        return await _get_or_create_serial(session, tenant_id, item.id, serial_code)
220	    raise ValidationFailedError(
221	        message="A serial number is required for this serial-tracked item",
222	        code="inventory.serial_required",
223	        details={"item_id": str(item.id)},
224	    )
225	
226	
227	async def _get_or_create_serial(
228	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID, serial_code: str
229	) -> uuid.UUID:
230	    existing = (
231	        await session.execute(
232	            select(SerialNumber).where(
233	                SerialNumber.tenant_id == tenant_id,
234	                SerialNumber.item_id == item_id,
235	                SerialNumber.serial_code == serial_code,
236	            )
237	        )
238	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
239	    if existing is not None:
240	        return existing.id
241	    serial = SerialNumber(
242	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
243	        item_id=item_id,
244	        serial_code=serial_code,
245	        status=SerialStatus.IN_STOCK.value,
246	        received_at=datetime.now(UTC),
247	    )
248	    session.add(serial)
249	    await session.flush()
250	    return serial.id

1	"""Inventory's cross-module read interface (STRUCTURE §5).
2	
3	Inventory sits just above finance in the dependency order: every module above it (procurement,
4	sales, manufacturing) may import THIS file to read inventory state synchronously, and inventory
5	imports only finance/queries downward. Keep this surface thin and stable — it is a contract; it is
6	the ONLY inventory file other modules import.
7	
8	For PLAN 5.1 it exposes the item-master reads those modules will need: existence checks, the
9	item's base UoM and costing method, and the category's GL-account wiring (so the COGS handler can
10	resolve where to post when stock issues land in 5.2+). PLAN 5.2 adds the ON-HAND projection reads
11	(``total_on_hand``, ``on_hand_by_bin``, ``on_hand_by_lot``) — what sales ATP and procurement will
12	call: they read the MAINTAINED ``inv_stock_quants`` projection (D-036), an indexed aggregate, never
13	an unbounded SUM over the move history (PERFORMANCE §1).
14	
15	Every function takes an explicit ``tenant_id`` and runs under the caller's tenant context, so the
16	D-007 filter applies on top of the explicit predicate — ordinary tenant-scoped reads, not a bypass.
17	"""
18	
19	import uuid
20	from decimal import Decimal
21	
22	from sqlalchemy import func, select
23	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
24	
25	from app.modules.inventory.constants import CostingMethod
26	from app.modules.inventory.models import (
27	    CostLayer,
28	    Item,
29	    ItemCategory,
30	    ItemValuation,
31	    StockQuant,
32	)
33	
34	
35	async def get_item(
36	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
37	) -> Item | None:
38	    """The item with ``item_id`` in the tenant, or None. Lets another module read an item's master
39	    fields (name, type, base UoM, costing method) without importing inventory models directly."""
40	    stmt = select(Item).where(Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id)
41	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
42	
43	
44	async def item_exists(
45	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
46	) -> bool:
47	    """Whether an item with ``item_id`` exists in the tenant. The cheap existence check a sales or
48	    procurement line uses to validate its item_id dimension (the inventory analogue of finance's
49	    ``account_exists_by_id``)."""
50	    stmt = select(Item.id).where(Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id)
51	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).first() is not None
52	
53	
54	async def get_costing_method(
55	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
56	) -> CostingMethod | None:
57	    """The item's costing method (D-020), or None if the item does not exist. The costing engine
58	    (5.3) reads this to choose moving-average vs FIFO; exposed so other modules can too."""
59	    stmt = select(Item.costing_method).where(
60	        Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id
61	    )
62	    value = (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
63	    return CostingMethod(value) if value is not None else None
64	
65	
66	async def get_base_uom(
67	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
68	) -> uuid.UUID | None:
69	    """The item's base UoM id (the unit it is stored/costed in), or None if the item does not
70	    exist. A document line in another UoM converts to this base via ``service.convert_quantity``."""
71	    stmt = select(Item.base_uom_id).where(
72	        Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id
73	    )
74	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one_or_none()
75	
76	
77	async def get_category_accounts(
78	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
79	) -> tuple[uuid.UUID | None, uuid.UUID | None, uuid.UUID | None] | None:
80	    """The GL-account wiring (inventory, COGS, price-difference) of an item's category (D-020),
81	    or None if the item does not exist. The COGS handler (5.2+) resolves where to post a goods
82	    issue from this tuple. Any element may be None when the category has not wired that account
83	    yet — the issuing flow validates presence before it posts. One join, item -> category."""
84	    stmt = (
85	        select(
86	            ItemCategory.inventory_account_id,
87	            ItemCategory.cogs_account_id,
88	            ItemCategory.price_difference_account_id,
89	        )
90	        .join(Item, Item.category_id == ItemCategory.id)
91	        .where(Item.tenant_id == tenant_id, Item.id == item_id)
92	    )
93	    row = (await session.execute(stmt)).first()
94	    return (row[0], row[1], row[2]) if row is not None else None
95	
96	
97	# --- On-hand projection reads (PLAN 5.2) --------------------------------------
98	# These read the MAINTAINED inv_stock_quants projection (D-036), kept in lock-step with the move
99	# ledger so on-hand is an indexed aggregate over a small current-state table, not a SUM over
100	# unbounded move history (PERFORMANCE §1). MoneyType/QuantityType propagation keeps the SUM exact on
101	# both engines (D-015); ``func.coalesce(..., 0)`` makes an item with no stock read 0, not None.
102	
103	
104	async def total_on_hand(
105	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
106	) -> Decimal:
107	    """Total on-hand quantity of an item across ALL bins and lots (PLAN 5.2). The number sales ATP
108	    starts from. Reads inv_stock_quants (the maintained projection), index-served by
109	    ``(tenant_id, item_id)``."""
110	    stmt = select(func.coalesce(func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty), 0)).where(
111	        StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id
112	    )
113	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one()
114	
115	
116	async def on_hand(
117	    session: AsyncSession,
118	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
119	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
120	    bin_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
121	    lot_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
122	) -> Decimal:
123	    """On-hand quantity of an item, optionally narrowed to one bin and/or one lot (PLAN 5.2). With
124	    no bin/lot this is ``total_on_hand``; with a bin it is that bin's stock; with a lot it is that
125	    lot's stock (in the bin if also given). Reads the maintained projection."""
126	    stmt = select(func.coalesce(func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty), 0)).where(
127	        StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id
128	    )
129	    if bin_id is not None:
130	        stmt = stmt.where(StockQuant.bin_id == bin_id)
131	    if lot_id is not None:
132	        stmt = stmt.where(StockQuant.lot_id == lot_id)
133	    return (await session.execute(stmt)).scalar_one()
134	
135	
136	async def on_hand_by_bin(
137	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
138	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
139	    """Per-bin on-hand totals for an item (PLAN 5.2): ``{bin_id: qty}`` summed across that bin's
140	    lots. Bins with zero net stock are absent (the move service deletes a quant when it hits 0, so
141	    the projection holds only live stock). What a bin-level stock-overview screen reads."""
142	    stmt = (
143	        select(StockQuant.bin_id, func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty))
144	        .where(StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id)
145	        .group_by(StockQuant.bin_id)
146	    )
147	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
148	    return {row[0]: row[1] for row in rows}
149	
150	
151	async def on_hand_by_lot(
152	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
153	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
154	    """Per-lot on-hand totals for a LOT-tracked item (PLAN 5.2): ``{lot_id: qty}`` summed across
155	    bins. Quants with a NULL lot (fungible stock) are excluded — this view is for tracked items
156	    where lot traceability matters."""
157	    stmt = (
158	        select(StockQuant.lot_id, func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty))
159	        .where(
160	            StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id,
161	            StockQuant.item_id == item_id,
162	            StockQuant.lot_id.is_not(None),
163	        )
164	        .group_by(StockQuant.lot_id)
165	    )
166	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
167	    return {row[0]: row[1] for row in rows}
168	
169	
170	# --- Valuation reads (PLAN 5.3, D-020/D-037) ----------------------------------
171	# These read the VALUE SSOT (inv_item_valuations for moving-average, inv_cost_layers for FIFO), kept
172	# in lock-step with every move in the same transaction (D-037). The inventory-value dashboard KPI
173	# and
174	# valuation reports read these. MoneyType/QuantityType propagation keeps the SUMs exact (D-015).
175	
176	
177	async def item_value(
178	    session: AsyncSession,
179	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
180	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
181	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
182	) -> Decimal:
183	    """The current total inventory VALUE of an item (PLAN 5.3), optionally narrowed to one
184	    warehouse.
185	
186	    For a MOVING_AVERAGE item this sums ``inv_item_valuations.total_value``; for a FIFO item it sums
187	    ``remaining_qty × unit_cost`` over the live cost layers. An item uses exactly one method, so the
188	    other source contributes 0. The FIFO product is summed in PYTHON (each factor already a typed
189	    Decimal) rather than ``func.sum(qty × cost)``, because multiplying two scaled-integer columns on
190	    SQLite yields a ×10^12 value that the MoneyType result processor cannot un-scale (D-015 trigger
191	    discipline: SQL never multiplies two stored money/quantity columns)."""
192	    valuation_stmt = select(
193	        func.coalesce(func.sum(ItemValuation.total_value), 0)
194	    ).where(ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id, ItemValuation.item_id == item_id)
195	    layer_stmt = select(CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
196	        CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id,
197	        CostLayer.item_id == item_id,
198	        CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0,
199	    )
200	    if warehouse_id is not None:
201	        valuation_stmt = valuation_stmt.where(ItemValuation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
202	        layer_stmt = layer_stmt.where(CostLayer.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
203	    mav_value = Decimal((await session.execute(valuation_stmt)).scalar_one())
204	    fifo_value = sum(
205	        (Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost) for qty, cost in (await session.execute(layer_stmt)).all()),
206	        Decimal(0),
207	    )
208	    return mav_value + fifo_value
209	
210	
211	async def valuation_summary(
212	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID
213	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
214	    """Total inventory value per item across the tenant (PLAN 5.3): ``{item_id: value}`` — the
215	    moving-average totals plus the FIFO live-layer values, merged per item. What the inventory-value
216	    dashboard KPI sums. The moving-average totals are grouped in SQL; the FIFO layer products are
217	    summed in Python per item (D-015: no SQL multiply of two scaled money/quantity columns).
218	    PERFORMANCE §6: two reads, no per-item N+1."""
219	    mav_rows = (
220	        await session.execute(
221	            select(ItemValuation.item_id, func.sum(ItemValuation.total_value))
222	            .where(ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id)
223	            .group_by(ItemValuation.item_id)
224	        )
225	    ).all()
226	    layer_rows = (
227	        await session.execute(
228	            select(CostLayer.item_id, CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
229	                CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id, CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0
230	            )
231	        )
232	    ).all()
233	    totals: dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal] = {}
234	    for item_id_, value in mav_rows:
235	        if value is not None:
236	            totals[item_id_] = totals.get(item_id_, Decimal(0)) + Decimal(value)
237	    for item_id_, qty, cost in layer_rows:
238	        totals[item_id_] = totals.get(item_id_, Decimal(0)) + Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost)
239	    return totals
240

1	"""Inventory stock topology + the move ledger + the maintained on-hand projection (PLAN 5.2).
2	
3	This file owns the four STOCK tables (the master tables live in ``models/masters.py``):
4	
5	- ``Warehouse`` / ``Bin``: the storage topology. A bin belongs to a warehouse; on-hand is tracked
6	  PER BIN. Both are reference data (codes, not gapless numbers).
7	- ``StockMove`` (``inv_stock_moves``): the quantity SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (D-020). One append-only
8	  ledger row per movement, POSTED at creation and IMMUTABLE — corrections are reversing moves,
9	  never edits (the universal-journal philosophy of D-017 applied to stock). Quantity is ALWAYS
10	  POSITIVE; the ``move_type`` decides which of from_bin/to_bin participate (the direction), so no
11	  signed column is needed (constants.MOVE_BIN_SIDES). Carries DocumentMixin (registered in
12	  core_documents) and a gapless STK number claimed at creation (D-012 claim-at-permanence — a move
13	  is permanent at create).
14	- ``StockQuant`` (``inv_stock_quants``): the MAINTAINED PROJECTION of the move ledger — current
15	  on-hand per (item, bin, lot). Updated in the SAME transaction as every move (the moving-average
16	  ``inv_item_valuations`` precedent, D-020), so on-hand reads are an indexed point-lookup, not an
17	  unbounded SUM over history (PERFORMANCE §1). The ledger stays the SSOT/audit trail; the quant is
18	  reconcilable from it. A DB ``CHECK (on_hand_qty >= 0)`` plus a pre-flight service check forbid
19	  negative stock outright (D-020) — both engines (a single-column CHECK is portable, D-022).
20	  Recorded as DECISIONS.md D-036.
21	
22	Indexes (PERFORMANCE §1) are declared so the on-hand sums and the move-ledger filters are
23	index-served: moves index (tenant, item, to_bin), (tenant, item, from_bin), (tenant, move_date) and
24	(tenant, item); quants index (tenant, item) on top of the natural-key UNIQUE.
25	
26	Enum-valued columns are plain ``sa.String`` storing the StrEnum's UPPER_SNAKE value (the
27	core/finance/masters convention); the service maps to/from the constants classes. Every table
28	follows the D-007 composite-tenant-FK backstop (``tenant_unique()`` + ``tenant_fk()`` composites).
29	"""

55	    convention). Audited (D-010): topology is master data. ``tenant_unique()`` so bins can reference

104	class StockMove(UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, AuditMixin, TimestampMixin, DocumentMixin, Base):
105	    """The quantity SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (D-020): one append-only ledger row per stock movement.
106	
107	    POSTED at creation and IMMUTABLE — a move is never edited or deleted; a correction is a NEW
108	    reversing move linked via docflow (the D-017 reversal philosophy applied to stock). ``quantity``
109	    is ALWAYS POSITIVE; ``move_type`` (constants.MoveType) decides which of ``from_bin_id`` /
110	    ``to_bin_id`` participate (constants.MOVE_BIN_SIDES) — so direction is structural, not a sign.

112	    so a later UoM change can't reinterpret history). ``lot_id`` / ``serial_id`` carry batch/serial

118	    orders/receipts branch). Audited (D-010): every quantity change is auditable. Indexes per
119	    PERFORMANCE §1 so the quant maintenance lookups and the ledger filters are index-served."""
120	
121	    __tablename__ = "inv_stock_moves"
122	    __table_args__ = (
123	        tenant_unique(),

125	        document_fk(),
126	        tenant_fk("inv_items", "item_id"),
127	        tenant_fk("inv_uoms", "base_uom_id"),

132	            ["tenant_id", "from_bin_id"],

138	            ["inv_bins.tenant_id", "inv_bins.id"],

140	        ),

144	        # the (tenant, item, to_bin) / (tenant, item, from_bin) indexes serve per-bin lookups, the
145	        # (tenant, move_date) index serves the ledger date filter, and (tenant, item) the
146	        # per-item ledger view.
147	        sa.Index(

151	            "to_bin_id",
152	        ),

155	            "tenant_id",
156	            "item_id",
157	            "from_bin_id",
158	        ),

160	        sa.Index("ix_inv_stock_moves_tenant_id_item_id", "tenant_id", "item_id"),
161	    )

164	    move_type: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(12), nullable=False)
165	    item_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
166	    quantity: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(QuantityType(), nullable=False)

190	    §1) — the moving-average ``inv_item_valuations`` precedent (D-020). The move ledger stays the

194	    hold several lots, each its own quant row). The ``CHECK (on_hand_qty >= 0)`` is the DB backstop

225	    bin_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
226	    lot_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=True)

1	"""The costing engine (PLAN 5.3, D-020/D-037): moving-average AND FIFO valuation per (item,
2	warehouse), computed in the SAME transaction as the stock move, right after the quant update and
3	BEFORE the move's costing event is published.
4	
5	The move ledger + quants stay the QUANTITY SSOT; ``inv_item_valuations`` (moving-average) and
6	``inv_cost_layers`` + ``inv_layer_consumptions`` (FIFO) are the VALUE SSOT (D-037). Which engine a
7	(item, warehouse) uses is the item's ``costing_method``.
8	
9	``apply_costing`` is the single entry point ``create_move`` calls. It:
10	1. resolves the move's direction + warehouse(s) from its bins,
11	2. runs the moving-average or FIFO update (receipt adds value, issue computes + removes it),
12	3. writes the computed cost back onto the move (``unit_cost``),
13	4. returns a ``CostingResult`` carrying the ``StockValued`` event (or None for a value-neutral
14	   within-warehouse transfer) for ``create_move`` to publish.
15	
16	Reversal: ``reverse_costing`` undoes a move's valuation symmetrically — a reversed ISSUE replays its
17	FIFO consumptions backward / re-adds moving-average value; a reversed RECEIPT zeros its layer /
18	removes moving-average value. The reversing move publishes the OPPOSITE costing event so the COGS
19	journal is reversed too.
20	
21	The moving-average row math lives in ``costing_mav.py`` and the FIFO layer mechanics in
22	``costing_fifo.py`` (split at the 400-line cap); this file owns the orchestration + reversal
23	sequencing + the StockValued event build.
24	"""
25	
26	from __future__ import annotations
27	
28	import uuid
29	from dataclasses import dataclass
30	from decimal import Decimal
31	
32	from sqlalchemy import select
33	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
34	
35	from app.core.exceptions import ValidationFailedError
36	from app.modules.finance import queries as finance_queries
37	from app.modules.inventory import queries as inventory_queries
38	from app.modules.inventory.constants import (
39	    DEFAULT_COSTING_CURRENCY,
40	    CostingMethod,
41	    MoveType,
42	)
43	from app.modules.inventory.events import StockValued
44	from app.modules.inventory.models import Bin, Item, StockMove
45	from app.modules.inventory.service import costing_fifo, costing_mav
46	
47	
48	@dataclass(frozen=True)
49	class CostingResult:
50	    """What ``apply_costing`` produced for one move: the computed unit cost (written onto the move)
51	    and the ``StockValued`` event to publish (None when the move moved no value — a within-warehouse
52	    transfer — so no journal is posted, D-037)."""
53	
54	    unit_cost: Decimal | None
55	    event: StockValued | None
56	
57	
58	async def _warehouse_of_bin(
59	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, bin_id: uuid.UUID
60	) -> uuid.UUID:
61	    """The warehouse a bin belongs to (valuation is per warehouse, not per bin — D-037). The bin was
62	    already validated by the move engine, so a missing one here is an invariant break, not user
63	    input."""
64	    warehouse_id = (
65	        await session.execute(
66	            select(Bin.warehouse_id).where(
67	                Bin.tenant_id == tenant_id, Bin.id == bin_id
68	            )
69	        )
70	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
71	    if warehouse_id is None:
72	        raise ValidationFailedError(
73	            message="The bin has no warehouse for valuation",
74	            code="inventory.costing_bin_warehouse_missing",
75	            details={"bin_id": str(bin_id)},
76	        )
77	    return warehouse_id
78	
79	
80	async def _costing_currency(session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID) -> str:
81	    """The currency the COGS/inventory journal posts in (D-015): the tenant's functional currency
82	    when configured, else the v1 single-currency default. Costs quantize to its decimals."""
83	    func_code = await finance_queries.functional_currency_or_none(session, tenant_id)
84	    return func_code or DEFAULT_COSTING_CURRENCY
85	
86	
87	async def _category_accounts(
88	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
89	) -> tuple[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID]:
90	    """The item category's three GL account ids (inventory, COGS, price-difference), REQUIRED before
91	    a stocked move can value (D-020/D-029). A STOCKED item whose category has not wired them cannot
92	    post a move — the value would have nowhere to land — so this raises a clear 422."""
93	    accounts = await inventory_queries.get_category_accounts(session, tenant_id, item_id)
94	    if accounts is None or any(account_id is None for account_id in accounts):
95	        raise ValidationFailedError(
96	            message="The item's category must wire inventory, COGS and price-difference accounts "
97	            "before stock can be valued",
98	            code="inventory.category_accounts_unwired",
99	            details={"item_id": str(item_id)},
100	        )
101	    return accounts  # type: ignore[return-value]
102	
103	
104	# --- Orchestration ------------------------------------------------------------
105	
106	
107	async def apply_costing(
108	    session: AsyncSession,
109	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
110	    item: Item,
111	    move: StockMove,
112	) -> CostingResult:
113	    """Run costing for a just-created move IN THE SAME TRANSACTION (D-020), after the quant update.
114	
115	    Resolves direction + warehouse(s), runs the moving-average or FIFO engine, writes the computed
116	    ``unit_cost`` back onto the move, and returns the ``StockValued`` event for ``create_move`` to
117	    publish (None for a value-neutral within-warehouse transfer). RECEIPT/positive-ADJUSTMENT use
118	    the
119	    move's passed ``unit_cost`` (the entry cost); ISSUE/negative-ADJUSTMENT IGNORE it and
120	    compute."""
121	    move_type = MoveType(move.move_type)
122	    qty = Decimal(move.quantity)
123	    method = CostingMethod(item.costing_method)
124	    currency_code = await _costing_currency(session, tenant_id)
125	    accounts = await _category_accounts(session, tenant_id, item.id)
126	
127	    from_warehouse_id = (
128	        await _warehouse_of_bin(session, tenant_id, move.from_bin_id)
129	        if move.from_bin_id is not None
130	        else None
131	    )
132	    to_warehouse_id = (
133	        await _warehouse_of_bin(session, tenant_id, move.to_bin_id)
134	        if move.to_bin_id is not None
135	        else None
136	    )

138	    if move_type == MoveType.TRANSFER:
139	        return await _apply_transfer(
140	            session, tenant_id, item, move, qty, method, currency_code,
141	            from_warehouse_id, to_warehouse_id,
142	        )

144	    # Direction is structural: a populated to_bin warehouse is inbound (RECEIPT / increase), a
145	    # populated from_bin warehouse is outbound (ISSUE / decrease). ADJUSTMENT sets exactly one side.
146	    if to_warehouse_id is not None:
147	        return await _apply_inbound(
148	            session, tenant_id, item, move, qty, method, to_warehouse_id, accounts
149	        )
150	    if from_warehouse_id is not None:
151	        return await _apply_outbound(
152	            session, tenant_id, item, move, qty, method, currency_code,
153	            from_warehouse_id, accounts,
154	        )

156	        message="The move has no warehouse side to value",

162	async def _apply_inbound(
163	    session: AsyncSession,
164	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
165	    item: Item,
166	    move: StockMove,
167	    qty: Decimal,
168	    method: CostingMethod,
169	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
170	    accounts: tuple[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID],
171	) -> CostingResult:
172	    """RECEIPT / positive ADJUSTMENT: stock enters at the move's REQUIRED ``unit_cost`` (the entry
173	    cost). Updates the moving-average row or creates a FIFO layer, and emits a value-increasing
174	    StockValued event the handler posts as Dr inventory."""
175	    unit_cost = _require_entry_cost(move)
176	    total_cost = qty * unit_cost
177	    if method == CostingMethod.MOVING_AVERAGE:
178	        await costing_mav.mav_receive(session, tenant_id, item.id, warehouse_id, qty, unit_cost)
179	    else:

192	    # A receipt / stock-increase offsets to the price-difference (inventory-adjustment) account: a
193	    # STANDALONE receipt has no procurement GR clearing yet (procurement overrides this later, 6.x).
194	    event = _build_event(
195	        move, warehouse_id, qty, total_cost, Decimal(0),
196	        inventory_account_id, price_diff_account_id, price_diff_account_id,
197	        is_inbound=True,

203	    session: AsyncSession,
204	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
205	    item: Item,
206	    move: StockMove,
207	    qty: Decimal,
208	    method: CostingMethod,
209	    currency_code: str,

211	    accounts: tuple[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID],
212	) -> CostingResult:
213	    """ISSUE / negative ADJUSTMENT: the engine COMPUTES the cost of the stock that left (the passed
214	    unit_cost is ignored). Moving average quantizes qty × avg + flushes residual at zero on-hand;
215	    FIFO sums per-layer quantized costs. Emits a value-decreasing StockValued event the handler
216	    posts
217	    as Dr COGS / Cr inventory."""
218	    residual_flush = Decimal(0)
219	    if method == CostingMethod.MOVING_AVERAGE:
220	        cogs, residual_flush = await costing_mav.mav_issue(

222	        )

229	            issue_move_id=move.id,

236	    # An ISSUE charges COGS (goods left for sale/production); an ADJUSTMENT-down is an inventory
237	    # write-off with no document behind it, so it offsets to the price-difference account (D-020).
238	    offset_account_id = (
239	        cogs_account_id
240	        if MoveType(move.move_type) == MoveType.ISSUE
241	        else price_diff_account_id
242	    )
243	    event = _build_event(
244	        move, warehouse_id, qty, cogs, residual_flush,
245	        inventory_account_id, offset_account_id, price_diff_account_id,
246	        is_inbound=False,
247	    )
