"""Physical / cycle count HTTP layer (PLAN 5.4), included into the inventory router.

A sibling sub-router mounted via ``router.include_router(count_router)`` so the module stays ONE
surface at ``/api/v1/inventory`` (the stock_router/valuation_router precedent — no second mount in
main.py). Covers count-session CRUD-ish lifecycle (create/populate/lines/start/post/cancel) and the
list/detail reads.

Permission-guarded (D-009): ``inventory.count.read`` for the reads, ``inventory.count.manage`` for
the data-entry phase (create/populate/lines/start/cancel), and the privileged
``inventory.count.post`` for posting (which books variance adjustment moves + their journals). Writes
commit through ``run_in_uow`` (D-011). Create and post are IDEMPOTENT (D-013): both produce
documents (the count itself, and the adjustment moves), so a retried request must not duplicate.

**The post sync/background split** (PERFORMANCE §3): the post endpoint counts the eligible
variances — up to ``STOCK_COUNT_POST_SYNC_MAX_VARIANCES`` (100) it posts inline (201) and returns
the count; above that it submits an ``inventory.count_post`` job and returns 202 {job_id} for
/api/v1/jobs polling (the depreciation-run precedent). The lists/details are
transactional/fast-changing, so they carry NO ETag.
"""

import uuid

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Response

from app.core.deps import CurrentUserDep, SessionDep, SessionFactoryDep
from app.core.events import run_in_uow
from app.core.idempotency import Idempotent, IdempotentDep
from app.core.jobs import schedule_job, submit_job
from app.core.pagination import CursorParams, cursor_params, map_page
from app.core.rbac import require_permission
from app.core.schemas import JobSubmitted, Page
from app.modules.inventory import service
from app.modules.inventory.constants import (
    INVENTORY_COUNT_MANAGE,
    INVENTORY_COUNT_POST,
    INVENTORY_COUNT_READ,
    STOCK_COUNT_POST_JOB,
    STOCK_COUNT_POST_SYNC_MAX_VARIANCES,
)
from app.modules.inventory.schemas import (
    StockCountCreate,
    StockCountFilter,
    StockCountLineCreate,
    StockCountLineRead,
    StockCountLineUpdate,
    StockCountPopulate,
    StockCountRead,
)

count_router = APIRouter(tags=["inventory-counts"])

CursorParamsDep = Depends(cursor_params)
_ReadGuard = Depends(require_permission(INVENTORY_COUNT_READ))
_ManageGuard = Depends(require_permission(INVENTORY_COUNT_MANAGE))
_PostGuard = Depends(require_permission(INVENTORY_COUNT_POST))
_CreateIdempotentDep = Depends(Idempotent("inventory.count.create"))
_PostIdempotentDep = Depends(Idempotent("inventory.count.post"))


# --- Create + lifecycle -------------------------------------------------------


@count_router.post(
    "/stock-counts", response_model=StockCountRead, status_code=201, dependencies=[_ManageGuard]
)
async def create_stock_count(
    payload: StockCountCreate,
    current: CurrentUserDep,
    session: SessionDep,
    idem: IdempotentDep = _CreateIdempotentDep,
) -> StockCountRead:
    """Create a DRAFT count session (PLAN 5.4). IDEMPOTENT (D-013): it claims a gapless CNT number,
    so a retried request must not burn a second number."""
    holder: dict[str, StockCountRead] = {}

    async def work() -> None:
        count = await service.create_count(session, current.tenant_id, payload)
        await session.refresh(count)
        holder["read"] = await idem.capture(
            StockCountRead.model_validate(count), status_code=201
        )

    await run_in_uow(session, work)
    return holder["read"]


@count_router.post(
    "/stock-counts/{count_id}/populate", response_model=dict, dependencies=[_ManageGuard]
)
async def populate_stock_count(
    count_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: StockCountPopulate,
    current: CurrentUserDep,
    session: SessionDep,
) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Snapshot current on-hand into count lines (PLAN 5.4): whole warehouse (PHYSICAL) or the
    filtered subset (CYCLE). Returns how many lines were added. Idempotent re-populate skips
    already-lined places."""
    holder: dict[str, int] = {}

    async def work() -> None:
        holder["added"] = await service.populate_count(
            session, current.tenant_id, count_id, payload
        )

    await run_in_uow(session, work)
    return {"added": holder["added"]}


@count_router.post(
    "/stock-counts/{count_id}/lines",
    response_model=StockCountLineRead,
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[_ManageGuard],
)
async def add_stock_count_line(
    count_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: StockCountLineCreate,
    current: CurrentUserDep,
    session: SessionDep,
) -> StockCountLineRead:
    """Manually add ONE count line for a place not snapshotted (PLAN 5.4)."""
    holder: dict[str, StockCountLineRead] = {}

    async def work() -> None:
        line = await service.add_line(session, current.tenant_id, count_id, payload)
        await session.refresh(line)
        holder["read"] = StockCountLineRead.model_validate(line)

    await run_in_uow(session, work)
    return holder["read"]


@count_router.patch(
    "/stock-counts/{count_id}/lines/{line_id}",
    response_model=StockCountLineRead,
    dependencies=[_ManageGuard],
)
async def update_stock_count_line(
    count_id: uuid.UUID,
    line_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: StockCountLineUpdate,
    current: CurrentUserDep,
    session: SessionDep,
) -> StockCountLineRead:
    """Set a line's counted quantity (PLAN 5.4); only while DRAFT/COUNTING."""
    holder: dict[str, StockCountLineRead] = {}

    async def work() -> None:
        line = await service.update_line(
            session, current.tenant_id, count_id, line_id, payload
        )
        await session.refresh(line)
        holder["read"] = StockCountLineRead.model_validate(line)

    await run_in_uow(session, work)
    return holder["read"]


@count_router.post(
    "/stock-counts/{count_id}/start", response_model=StockCountRead, dependencies=[_ManageGuard]
)
async def start_stock_count(
    count_id: uuid.UUID, current: CurrentUserDep, session: SessionDep
) -> StockCountRead:
    """DRAFT → COUNTING (PLAN 5.4)."""
    holder: dict[str, StockCountRead] = {}

    async def work() -> None:
        count = await service.start_counting(session, current.tenant_id, count_id)
        await session.refresh(count)
        holder["read"] = StockCountRead.model_validate(count)

    await run_in_uow(session, work)
    return holder["read"]


@count_router.post(
    "/stock-counts/{count_id}/cancel", response_model=StockCountRead, dependencies=[_ManageGuard]
)
async def cancel_stock_count(
    count_id: uuid.UUID, current: CurrentUserDep, session: SessionDep
) -> StockCountRead:
    """Abandon a count before posting (PLAN 5.4): DRAFT/COUNTING → CANCELLED."""
    holder: dict[str, StockCountRead] = {}

    async def work() -> None:
        count = await service.cancel_count(session, current.tenant_id, count_id)
        await session.refresh(count)
        holder["read"] = StockCountRead.model_validate(count)

    await run_in_uow(session, work)
    return holder["read"]


# --- Post (inline / 202-job split) --------------------------------------------


async def _post_inline(
    count_id: uuid.UUID,
    current: CurrentUserDep,
    session: SessionDep,
    idem: IdempotentDep,
) -> StockCountRead:
    holder: dict[str, StockCountRead] = {}

    async def work() -> None:
        count = await service.post_count(session, current.tenant_id, count_id)
        await session.refresh(count)
        holder["read"] = await idem.capture(
            StockCountRead.model_validate(count), status_code=201
        )

    await run_in_uow(session, work)
    return holder["read"]


async def _post_background(
    count_id: uuid.UUID,
    current: CurrentUserDep,
    session: SessionDep,
    factory: SessionFactoryDep,
    idem: IdempotentDep,
) -> JobSubmitted:
    holder: dict[str, JobSubmitted] = {}
    job_id_holder: dict[str, uuid.UUID] = {}

    async def work() -> None:
        job = await submit_job(
            session,
            current.tenant_id,
            STOCK_COUNT_POST_JOB,
            {"count_id": str(count_id)},
            submitted_by=current.user_id,
        )
        job_id_holder["job_id"] = job.id
        holder["read"] = await idem.capture(
            JobSubmitted(job_id=job.id, status=job.status), status_code=202
        )

    await run_in_uow(session, work)
    schedule_job(job_id_holder["job_id"], factory)
    return holder["read"]


@count_router.post(
    "/stock-counts/{count_id}/post",
    response_model=StockCountRead | JobSubmitted,
    status_code=201,
    dependencies=[_PostGuard],
)
async def post_stock_count(
    count_id: uuid.UUID,
    current: CurrentUserDep,
    session: SessionDep,
    factory: SessionFactoryDep,
    response: Response,
    idem: IdempotentDep = _PostIdempotentDep,
) -> StockCountRead | JobSubmitted:
    """Post a count (PLAN 5.4): book an ADJUSTMENT move per non-zero variance (reusing the 5.3
    costing/event path to the price-difference journal — no journal code here). ≤100 eligible
    variances post inline (201 count); larger submit an ``inventory.count_post`` job (202 {job_id}).
    IDEMPOTENT (D-013): a retry replays, never double-posts."""
    eligible = await service.counted_line_count(session, current.tenant_id, count_id)

    return await _post_inline(count_id, current, session, idem)
